summary: Molecular Partners AG filed a Form 6-K on July 20, 2026, attaching a July 16 press release. The release announced clinical progress in a Phase 2 investigator-initiated trial of MP0317 for cholangiocarcinoma, with nine sites recruiting and patient treatment ongoing. It expects a data update in 2027 and completion in 2028. No financial terms, board actions, or corporate transactions are disclosed. This is a routine operational and clinical update, not a special situation. The filing is a foreign private issuer report of a press release, with no M&A, activism, restructuring, or other special event.
